mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 54 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library, and we have a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The City of Verona has updated its polling information, adding two new locations for a total of four sites. Residents should check the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm if their designated polling place has changed before heading out to vote.
Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy update, officers reported that on October 7th, a 17-year-old riding an electric motorcycle was involved in a collision at Basswood Avenue and Hemlock Drive.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, featuring today's flavor, Crazy for Cookie Dough. Be sure to stop by before they close at 10:00 PM.
